# v1.5.1 - Water Helper Fixes, Auto-Update 404 Fallback & Always-on-Top Dialogs

## English
- Water reminder popup: now a focusable topmost window with fade-in/out animations, fixable close button; live countdown tick; panel hint text and settings button removed; settings page uses form layout and follows light/dark theme.
- Water panel opens non-modally, the floating widget stays clickable/draggable while it is open.
- Auto-update: when the manifest download URL returns 404, the updater now falls back to the real latest GitHub Release asset automatically; update dialogs are always-on-top; failure dialog offers a direct link to the Releases page.
notes_zh:
# v1.5.1 - 喝水助手修复 + 自动更新 404 回退 + 弹窗置顶

## 中文
- 提醒弹窗改为可聚焦置顶窗口，带淡入淡出动画，可正常关闭；时间实时递减；面板底部提示文字与设置按钮已移除；设置页表单化并完整适配深浅主题。
- 喝水助手面板改为非模态打开，打开期间浮窗仍可单击与拖动。
- 自动更新：清单下载地址 404 时自动回退到 GitHub 最新正式版实际资产；更新弹窗全部置顶；下载失败弹窗提供一键打开 Releases 页面。
